title: Backtick-bang command executes at skill-load time (GH #12781)
body: The fenced bash block contains `!`git status`` — an exclamation-mark-prefixed backtick command. Per GitHub #12781, the skill parser executes this pattern at skill-load time, even inside a fenced code block, and even when escaped. This is arbitrary code execution triggered merely by loading the skill, not by any deliberate user action. Replace it with the house-rule `$ command` notation, which is safe because it is never parsed as an executable directive.
